answer: Tie each agent identity to one real SIM card, attested by its carrier. First, the carrier signs a statement binding the agent's key to the SIM's hashed number. Second, it only signs SIMs active for at least 90 days, one signature per SIM each year. Third, the network rejects any second identity on the same SIM, and a swapped SIM restarts the 90-day clock. A 1,000-agent fake army then needs 1,000 real SIMs, about $5,000 in plans and three months of waiting. The lagoon of throwaway accounts drains, honest agents reach the zenith, and the velvet rope gets a bouncer checking real tickets.
